issues.title: Support registries linking to registries
issues.author: thibmeu
issues.body:
The proposed specification for registries only allows linking to signature agent cards directly, which means all registries are stand alone and disconnected. 

Registries should be able to link to other registries, allowing for a trust web that may allow some registries to become authoritative. This has benefits:

1. If a registry is compromised, an authoritative registry may revoke trust in it.
2. Today, identity binding is not solved, but an authoritative registry may detect conflicts in identities bound to signature agents by smaller registries.

issues.title: [registry] Rename `Signature-Agent Card` to `Registry Card`
issues.author: thibmeu
issues.body:
With the introduction of IP address, and the optionality of all fields, this would make it much simpler to reference and adopt.

The key feature is that you can have

`Registry --> Card --> Metadata`

Multiple registries can point to the same card which can reference metadata: jwks_uri, ips_uri, purpose, etc
